runtime_prompt_en:
Photograph an unmistakably adult 23-year-old East Asian woman on a quiet grassy hill beneath a sweeping Milky Way. Her facial appearance follows the attached portrait: a neat chin-length dark-brown bob with wispy bangs, round black wire-frame glasses, large dark-brown eyes, and softly natural features. Treat the portrait as the sole identity source, preserving her adult facial structure, eye shape and spacing, face length, and jaw width. She enjoys a literary-minded stargazing outing in a cream blouse and navy cardigan; an open poetry book rests on a blanket. Beside her, she adjusts the focus of a portable astronomical telescope while a mirrorless camera records the sky from a second tripod. A breeze turns one page as she looks upward. Place the telescope in the left foreground and her slightly right of center, its diagonal tube leading toward the galactic band. Warm lantern light and cool blue moonlight share a believable direction across her face, glasses, grass, and equipment. Use a realistic medium-wide environmental portrait, 35 mm perspective, depth separation, restrained high-ISO grain, and a richly detailed yet believable star field.

Avoid: broken facial features, impossible perspective, excessive HDR, body distortion, warped walls, 3D render look, distorted fingers, illustration look
